name: LLE-based Transfer Function Design
aliases: Local Linear Embedding (LLE) for Dimension Reduction
Local Linear Embedding (LLE) for TF Design
Local Linear Embedding for TF design
definition: A method to design high-dimensional transfer functions by projecting multi-dimensional volume parameters into a 2D space using Local Linear Embedding (LLE), followed by k-mean classification to assign colors, allowing users to interactively design TFs in 2D.
summary: LLE-based Transfer Function Design maps high-dimensional volume data to a 2D space by preserving local neighborhood structures, distinguishing itself from PCA by capturing nonlinear manifolds.
